title: Misha, Grisha and Underground
statementMd:
Misha and Grisha are funny boys, so they like to use new underground. The underground has $*n*$ stations connected with $*n* - 1$ routes so that each route connects two stations, and it is possible to reach every station from any other.

The boys decided to have fun and came up with a plan. Namely, in some day in the morning Misha will ride the underground from station $*s*$ to station $*f*$ by the shortest path, and will draw with aerosol an ugly text "Misha was here" on every station he will pass through (including $*s*$ and $*f*$). After that on the same day at evening Grisha will ride from station $*t*$ to station $*f*$ by the shortest path and will count stations with Misha's text. After that at night the underground workers will wash the texts out, because the underground should be clean.

The boys have already chosen three stations $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$ for each of several following days, one of them should be station $*s*$ on that day, another should be station $*f*$, and the remaining should be station $*t*$. They became interested how they should choose these stations $*s*$, $*f*$, $*t*$ so that the number Grisha will count is as large as possible. They asked you for help.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of stations and the number of days.

The second line contains $*n* - 1$ integers $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$). The integer $*p*_{*i*}$ means that there is a route between stations $*p*_{*i*}$ and $*i*$. It is guaranteed that it's possible to reach every station from any other.

The next $*q*$ lines contains three integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$ each ($1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c* ≤ *n*$) — the ids of stations chosen by boys for some day. Note that some of these ids could be same.

## Output

Print $*q*$ lines. In the $*i*$-th of these lines print the maximum possible number Grisha can get counting when the stations $*s*$, $*t*$ and $*f*$ are chosen optimally from the three stations on the $*i*$-th day.

## Note

In the first example on the first day if $*s*$ = $1$, $*f*$ = $2$, $*t*$ = $3$, Misha would go on the route $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$, and Grisha would go on the route $3$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$. He would see the text at the stations $1$ and $2$. On the second day, if $*s*$ = $3$, $*f*$ = $2$, $*t*$ = $3$, both boys would go on the route $3$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$. Grisha would see the text at $3$ stations.

In the second examle if $*s*$ = $1$, $*f*$ = $3$, $*t*$ = $2$, Misha would go on the route $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $3$, and Grisha would go on the route $2$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $3$ and would see the text at both stations.
statementZhMd:
米沙和格里沙是两个有趣的男孩，所以他们喜欢乘坐新的地下铁。地下铁有 $*n*$ 个车站，由 $*n* - 1$ 条线路连接，每条线路连接两个车站，并且从任意一个车站都可以到达其他任意车站。

男孩们决定找点乐子，并制定了一个计划。具体来说，在某天早上，米沙将从车站 $*s*$ 乘坐地下铁，沿最短路径前往车站 $*f*$，并在他经过的每个车站（包括 $*s*$ 和 $*f*$）上用喷漆写下难看的文字“​​Misha was here”。当天晚上，格里沙将从车站 $*t*$ 沿最短路径前往车站 $*f*$，并统计带有米沙所写文字的车站数量。之后在夜间，地下铁工作人员会将这些文字清洗掉，因为地下铁应该保持干净。

男孩们已经为接下来的若干天分别选定了三个车站 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$，其中一个应作为当天的车站 $*s*$，另一个作为车站 $*f*$，剩下的一个作为车站 $*t*$。他们想知道，应该如何从这三个车站中选择 $*s*$、$*f*$ 和 $*t*$，使格里沙统计到的车站数量尽可能多。他们向你寻求帮助。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$）——车站数量和天数。

第二行包含 $*n* - 1$ 个整数 $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。整数 $*p*_{*i*}$ 表示车站 $*p*_{*i*}$ 和 $*i*$ 之间存在一条线路。保证从任意一个车站都可以到达其他任意车站。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$（$1 ≤ *a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$ ≤ *n*$）——男孩们为某一天选定的车站编号。注意，这些编号中可能有相同的编号。

## 输出格式

输出 $*q*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行输出在第 $*i*$ 天从三个给定车站中最优选择车站 $*s*$、$*t*$ 和 $*f*$ 时，格里沙统计到的最大车站数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例的第一天，如果 $*s*$ = $1$、$*f*$ = $2$、$*t*$ = $3$，米沙将沿线路 $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$ 行进，而格里沙将沿线路 $3$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$ 行进。他会在车站 $1$ 和 $2$ 看到文字。第二天，如果 $*s*$ = $3$、$*f*$ = $2$、$*t*$ = $3$，两个男孩都会沿线路 $3$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$ 行进。格里沙会在 $3$ 个车站看到文字。

在第二个样例中，如果 $*s*$ = $1$、$*f*$ = $3$、$*t*$ = $2$，米沙将沿线路 $1$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $2$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $3$ 行进，而格里沙将沿线路 $2$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) $3$ 行进，并会在两个车站都看到文字。
